header.description: Real signatures over the signing hashes the tests produce, by two fixed keys, with the signed serialization of each by viem. Keyed by the 0x signing hash. A is the configured sender; B is another signer.
header.regenerate: In a directory with `npm install viem@2.57.16`: node <repo>/contract/vectors/gen-evm-signatures.mjs > <repo>/contract/vectors/evm-signatures.json
header.keys: A = keccak256("minder evm signing fixture key A v1"), B = keccak256("minder evm signing fixture key B v1"): derived from public strings, control no funds, not secrets
